tickets.body: Since setting up the API integration we've also had a related issue with the budget variance alert - it's meant to fire when a cost centre exceeds 5% variance, but it's triggering at roughly 2%, flooding half the finance team's inboxes with false positives. We've had to mute several of these overnight just to get through email. Could you check whether the threshold logic changed recently, or if this is something on our config side?

tickets.subject: Report builder crashing on multi-entity consolidation
tickets.body: The consolidated P&L report we build monthly across our six entities has started timing out in the report builder whenever we add more than four entity filters at once - it worked fine through September. We've had to split it into three separate reports and stitch them together in Excel before circulating to the board, which defeats half the point of having this built centrally. This is taking real time out of month-end close and needs a proper look, not a workaround on our end.

tickets.subject: Dashboard load times since the consolidation issue
tickets.body: Following on from the report builder ticket a couple of weeks ago - we're now also seeing the finance dashboards themselves taking 20-30 seconds to load for the same six-entity view, where they used to load in a few seconds. A couple of the team have started pulling numbers into Excel directly rather than waiting on the dashboard during close week, which isn't ideal given what we pay for the platform. Could someone check whether this is linked to the same underlying issue?

tickets.subject: Connector sync delays - flagging for the record
tickets.body: It's been a few months since the dashboard and report builder issues from last autumn, and while those specific bugs seem to have quieted down, the underlying connector sync between our ERP and the platform is still running six to eight hours behind during month-end, same as it was in October. We've restructured our close process around a manual export into Excel at the point we actually need the numbers, so this isn't blocking us day to day. Raising it mainly so it's on record rather than expecting an urgent fix at this stage.
